scope: The two Retry-After HTTP-date tests build their fake server's retry time with a new helper (now rounded down + 6s) instead of now + 5s; the asserted 5 +/- 1 window is unchanged.
reason: OME-1507: an HTTP-date drops fractions of a second, so now + 5s could parse as 3.9996s and fail CI at random (#1258, #1268). Test-only; the owner approved filing and fixing it.
